# TPC-Havoc Q13_v8

```{tags} reference, query-template, tpchavoc
```

> [TPC-Havoc](../../tpc-havoc.md) benchmark · [all TPC-Havoc queries](index.md)

## Representative SQL

Rendered for **DataFusion** with default parameters.

```sql
SELECT c_count, COUNT(*) AS custdist FROM (SELECT c_custkey, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders AS o WHERE o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 WHERE o.o_comment LIKE '%special%requests%')) AS c_count FROM customer AS c) AS c_orders GROUP BY c_count ORDER BY custdist DESC, c_count DESC
```
